subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Secret Police
description: A fast breakdown of The Secret Police for builders.

hook.text: Napoleon's police chief Fouché built the first modern secret police. He knew everything about everyone.

buildup.text: Fouché recruited informants in every neighborhood, salon, and workplace across France.

discovery.text: His network let Napoleon crush dissent before it organized. Surveillance became a tool of state power.

twist.text: The model spread. Every authoritarian regime since has built its own version of Fouché's network.

climax.text: The Stasi, KGB, and Gestapo all followed the same blueprint: informants, files, and fear.

punchline.text: Know everything. Control everyone. The oldest playbook.

quiz.question: Who built the first modern secret police network?
